budget_items.what_was_said: The commission was told the two remaining sewer connections at 100 Laurel Lane were finished in-house with the DPW and a masonry contractor, coming in well under the original estimate. DPW labor time still needed to be tallied but was not expected to add much.

Staff presented a spreadsheet calculating the total connection fee owed for the condo units tying into an existing line, based on the original betterment amount and a half-betterment privilege fee charged per additional unit. The property owner had already seen and accepted the calculation and was expected to pay.

Staff reported that town counsel, after meeting with the DPW director and staff, recommended the commission continue charging half of the betterment as the privilege fee, as it is defensible if challenged in court.

decisions.decision: 100 Laurel Lane sewer connection item removed from the agenda as complete.
Privilege fee item removed from the agenda after town counsel's recommendation to keep charging half the betterment was accepted.
Commission will continue asking contractors to informally check for and report on inflow/infiltration issues near connections when work is being done, even without a formal betterment charge.
67 Pratt Street privilege fee assessment added to a future agenda item.
CTE O&M contract item stays on the agenda until the town manager signs it, so the commission can then approve going out to bid.
Arthur will send a letter of resignation, with his resignation date, to Bill Bernard so the commission can begin looking for a replacement.

what_happened.line: Town counsel recommended, and the commission accepted, continuing to charge half the betterment amount as the privilege fee on new sewer connections.
Commissioner Arthur announced his resignation over a new work schedule; the board will begin searching for a replacement once he sends a formal letter.
The two remaining sewer connections at 100 Laurel Lane were finished in-house with DPW and a masonry contractor, coming in under the original estimate.
A connection fee for condo units at 786-796 Massachusetts Ave, based on the betterment and privilege-fee formula, was presented and accepted by the property owner.
The commission will keep asking contractors to informally flag inflow/infiltration issues near connection work, without a formal betterment charge.

why_it_matters: Anyone connecting to town sewer, including at 67 Pratt Street next, will be charged under the same half-betterment privilege fee formula town counsel just reaffirmed as legally defensible.
The commission loses a member and will be recruiting a replacement, which affects who sets sewer connection and rate policy going forward.
The Laurel Lane repair closing under budget and in-house limits added cost pressure on the sewer enterprise fund, which residents' sewer fees support.
